ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected chapter Surah Yusuf has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected chapter Surah Yusuf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected chapter Surah Yusuf.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Science of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Science of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Hadith.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bequest? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bequest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Bequest has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bequest.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Inheritance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Inheritance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inheritance.
   D. Say Inheritance has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Care for the elderly? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for the elderly has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for the elderly.
   C. Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Care for the elderly to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.
   C. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

10. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.
   B. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Islamic Law? (1 mark)
   A. Say Administration of Islamic Law has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Islamic Law.
   D. Use Administration of Islamic Law to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

14. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic values? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic values.
   C. Use Islamic values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic values has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim Scholars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain World Religions: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Science of Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Science of Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Administration of Islamic Law and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Inheritance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Bequest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
